scope: first complete semantic pass, canonical ordinals 9497-9537

findings.source: Raskolnikov: Знаю, струсил, но понял, что пока не готов.
findings.currentTarget: Raskolnikov: Știu, m-am speriat, dar mi-am dat seama că încă nu sunt pregătit.
findings.reason: Russian «струсил» is an admission that he lost his nerve or acted cowardly after wanting to witness killing. Romanian «m-am speriat» reports fear alone and drops his self-judgment about failing to act.
findings.proposedTarget: Raskolnikov: Știu, am fost laș, dar mi-am dat seama că încă nu sunt pregătit.
